country_decisions: The labour law's employer and employment registration duties, occupational and industry classifications, inspection powers and severity scale, complaint categories, injury reporting categories and periods, notice periods (none ship).

library.title: Register an employment relationship
library.intro: The employer registers a worker's employment. For a worker who is not a national the work authorisation is checked with the immigration authority; an unanswered check holds or refers the case, never refuses it.
library.filled_by: The employer or its authorised representative, online or at an office; or an official from a paper form.
library.authority: The labour authority the nation names for the labour slot (authorityFor('labour'), shipped empty). Never a ministry by name.

policies.access.read_rule: canReadLabour() in lib/auth/roles.ts: the labour authority's officials; auditors with a purpose; every read in the access log
policies.access.others: Other institutions learn only an employer's standing through employer.standing

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it
No field scores a person, a household, a credential, an employer or an application: no risk, credibility, propensity or match score exists in the contract or its procedure
deviations.why: Directions §15.6 and §15.7; supplement Part 15: a risk score alone cannot determine loss of essential support; field series Part 4 §4.4: no opaque risk scores.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Immigration and Customs ("never a score"); lib/social/procedures.ts refuses a suspension whose grounds rest on a score

deviations.what: The labour authority is the institution the nation names for the labour slot, shipped empty; until it is named no case opens
deviations.why: Specification Part 2 §A.6: the government assigns these functions.

deviations.what: An amount a person states (a remuneration, a claimed wage, a salary range) is recorded as a whole number of minor units, never a calculated money field
deviations.why: The platform calculates money only by an approved rule (lib/law/rules.ts); a stated figure is evidence, never a charge or entitlement.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md: rates, bands and tariffs come only from lib/law/rules.ts

quotes: Owns: employer registrations where assigned, inspection cases, findings, corrective orders and employment-service referrals.
It must not see private medical information without specific authority.

platform.how: Employers, inspections with findings and corrective orders, employment-service referrals; injury medical content only as a sealed document

quotes: Indicators: inspections completed, outstanding corrective actions, complaint age bands, resolution time, repeat findings and employment-service outcomes.
Do not publish identifying complainant details or imply that an allegation is a proven violation.

platform.how: labourCounts() carries no complainant or employer; a complaint is upheld only on findings (labour.checkOutcome)
